statements.status_notes: zip is compiled into ddtrace's Rust extension (ddtrace/internal/native/_native). The flaw is a skipped HMAC check when the reader of an AES-encrypted entry reaches EOF early, in the AES reader that ZipArchive uses to read entries. The shipped extension uses the ZipWriter path only; it contains no ZipArchive, ZipStreamReader or src/read code.

zip is compiled into ddtrace's Rust extension (ddtrace/internal/native/_native). The flaw is an unbounded allocation for symlink targets in ZipArchive::extract_internal (src/read). The shipped extension uses the ZipWriter path only; it contains no ZipArchive, ZipStreamReader or src/read code.
